verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's API docs state that anything you can do in the dashboard can also be done via the Admin/Management API, which covers creating, updating and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments and users. An official MCP server and CLI built on that API back up the parity claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of full UI-API parity, and a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed docs paths returned 404).
